_README: Label id -> structure name for the male genioglossus derived directly from his OWN CT tongue label
(head_muscles.nii.gz label 9, TotalSegmentator), not cryo. Position-anchored on his mandibular
symphysis midline (craniofacial_structures.nii.gz label 1, mandible) via scripts/cryo/vhm_genioglossus_from_ct.py,
replicating the geometric core of scripts/cryo/vhf_hyoid_muscles_from_cryo.py's tongue_rules() (paramedian
fan dxT < 10 mm of the mandibular midline, gT (AP fraction within the tongue mask, per-column) > 0.25,
below the dorsum's top 8 mm) directly in native CT voxel space -- no cryo texture needed for this split.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 `head_muscles` (tongue) and `craniofacial_structures` (mandible) labels. Rule adapted from scripts/cryo/vhf_hyoid_muscles_from_cryo.py's tongue_rules(), itself from Standring S (ed.), Gray's Anatomy, 42nd ed., ch. 30 'Oral cavity'. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhm_genioglossus_from_ct.py), rule-based.

genioglossus_right.note: 12.17 cm3; rule-based from his own CT tongue label, position-anchored on his mandibular symphysis midline; replaces the cross-body-transferred xfer_vhf2vhm_neck copy.

genioglossus_left.note: 11.25 cm3; rule-based from his own CT tongue label, position-anchored on his mandibular symphysis midline; replaces the cross-body-transferred xfer_vhf2vhm_neck copy.
